articulation.label: snow
articulation.alt: snow: /s/ → /n/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

sections: In winter, Puck wears a scarf and gloves when he goes outside. One glove is missing, so he looks under his coat. After finding it, he joins Heart in the garden. They build a snowman. Heart makes a small snowball for its nose and adds two dark stones for its eyes.
